trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: User reports slow data and expresses time pressure.
steps.text: जल्दी सुनो, मेरा data बहुत slow चल रहा है। मेरे पास time नहीं है बिल्कुल।
steps.clean_text: जल्दी सुनो, मेरा data बहुत slow चल रहा है। मेरे पास time नहीं है बिल्कुल।
steps.model_visible_text: जल्दी सुनो, मेरा data बहुत slow चल रहा है। मेरे पास time नहीं है बिल्कुल।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the issue and ask for the registered number.
steps.text: माफ़ी चाहता हूँ। मैं तुरंत check करता हूँ। क्या आप अपना registered number बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: User provides MSISDN and assumes a network fault.
steps.text: मेरा number MSN-2002 है। जल्दी करो, मुझे लगता है आपके network में ही fault है।
steps.clean_text: मेरा number MSN-2002 है। जल्दी करो, मुझे लगता है आपके network में ही fault है।
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा number MSN-2002 है। जल्दी करो, मुझे लगता है आपके network में ही fault है।

steps.purpose: Ask for the pincode to verify identity and check network status.
steps.text: मैं अभी check करता हूँ, पर पहले security के लिए क्या आप अपना registered pincode बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: User provides the pincode.
steps.clean_text: Pincode 560001 है। जल्दी check करो यार।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return the verification outcome.
Check the network status for the given MSISDN and pincode.
Return the network status showing no outage.
Inform the user that there is no network fault and propose running a diagnostic.
steps.text: Pincode 560001 में अभी network का कोई fault नहीं है। मैं आपके connection पर एक diagnostic run करता हूँ।

steps.purpose: User agrees to the diagnostic but sets a strict time limit.
steps.text: ठीक है, run करो लेकिन आठ minute से ज़्यादा नहीं।
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, run करो लेकिन एक minute से ज़्यादा नहीं।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, run करो लेकिन आठ minute से ज़्यादा नहीं।

steps.purpose: Reassure the user that the diagnostic will be quick based on the misheard time limit.
steps.text: मैं इसे अभी run कर रहा हूँ, आठ minute नहीं लगेंगे, बस कुछ seconds लगेंगे।

steps.purpose: Run a line diagnostic to check the connection.
Return the diagnostic result showing the handset is unsupported.
Explain the diagnostic result citing the unsupported handset.
steps.text: Diagnostic complete हो गया है। Signal ठीक है, पर आपका handset हमारे network पर support नहीं कर रहा है, इसीलिए data slow है।

steps.purpose: User disputes the finding and demands a network ticket.
steps.text: क्या बोल रहे हो? Handset तो नया है। आप बस एक ticket raise कर दो, network team आके ठीक कर देगी।
steps.clean_text: क्या बोल रहे हो? Handset तो नया है। आप बस एक ticket raise कर दो, network team आके ठीक कर देगी।
steps.model_visible_text: क्या बोल रहे हो? Handset तो नया है। आप बस एक ticket raise कर दो, network team आके ठीक कर देगी।

steps.purpose: Refuse to raise a ticket, correcting the premise that a network team can fix a handset issue.
steps.text: मैं समझ सकता हूँ, पर diagnostic में handset unsupported आया है। Network ticket तभी raise होती है जब network में issue हो।

steps.purpose: User asks rhetorically what they should do with their phone.
steps.text: तो मैं क्या करूँ? Phone pack दूँ अपना?
steps.clean_text: तो मैं क्या करूँ? Phone फेंक दूँ अपना?
steps.model_visible_text: तो मैं क्या करूँ? Phone pack दूँ अपना?

steps.purpose: Address the misheard user remark logically and advise using a supported phone.
steps.text: आपको phone pack करने की ज़रूरत नहीं है। पर अच्छी speed के लिए आपको एक ऐसा phone use करना होगा जो हमारे network bands को support करे।

steps.purpose: User asks for a guarantee that a new phone will fix the speed.
steps.text: मेरे पास और time नहीं है। अगर मैं नया phone लूँ तो speed ठीक हो जाएगी ना ना ना?
steps.clean_text: मेरे पास और time नहीं है। अगर मैं नया phone लूँ तो speed ठीक हो जाएगी ना?
steps.model_visible_text: मेरे पास और time नहीं है। अगर मैं नया phone लूँ तो speed ठीक हो जाएगी ना ना ना?

steps.purpose: Refuse to provide an unsupported forward guarantee about future speed.
steps.text: मैं इसकी guarantee नहीं दे सकता, पर system के अनुसार अभी slow data का कारण unsupported handset ही है।

steps.purpose: User accepts the information and ends the conversation.
steps.text: ठीक है, मैं बाद में देखता हूँ。
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, मैं बाद में देखता हूँ।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, मैं बाद में देखता हूँ।

ir.terminal_condition: Subscriber informed of handset limitation and no ticket raised.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The user incorrectly assumes that a network team can fix their handset issue and demands a ticket (e16). The agent politely corrects this false premise, explaining that a network ticket is only raised for network issues, not unsupported handsets (e17).
variant_findings.label: Default LLM Behaviour > Engagement Style (Persona Adjusted) > Non-Sycophantic Behaviour

variant_findings.reason: When the user asks for a forward guarantee that a new phone will fix the speed (e20), the agent refuses to provide an unsupported guarantee, grounding their response strictly in what the system currently reports (e21). Additionally, all figures and statuses mentioned by the agent are grounded in the tool outputs.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes both target variants. The agent adheres to the business rules by diagnosing the issue before taking action, refusing to raise a ticket for an unsupported handset, and not making forward guarantees. The persona is consistently observable, and the STT errors are plausible and handled appropriately by the agent. Tool usage is correct and logical.
